title: [Performance][Kernel] Optimize hc_pre kernels/main
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it

Integrate an optimized `hc_pre` operator implementation for evaluation on Ascend A3. The operator source was adapted from the [cann-recipes-infer implementation](https://gitcode.com/renruhai/cann-recipes-infer/tree/master/ops/ascendc/src/hc_pre).

The changes are limited to the operator implementation and its build integration. They also include a follow-up HF32 mode fix. The Python API and model call sites are unchanged. This PR does not claim an A5 performance improvement.

### Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?

There is no change to the inputs or outputs for supported configurations. 

### How was this patch tested?

- Built and installed the custom operator on Ascend A3.
- Ran the existing single-card `hc_pre` correctness tests after the HF32 fix: 5 passed. 
- Compared pre-optimization commit `cc06c1e5` with fixed optimized commit `648d8b6d` on the same Ascend910_9382 host using GLM-5.3-Flash W8A8. The `hc_pre` source at `648d8b6d` matches this PR. The figures are median `HcPre` device durations from the same DP0/TP0 rank.

| Capture | Input shape | Calls per version | Baseline | Optimized | Change |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Prefill | `[432, 4, 4096]` | 90 | 112.758 μs | 68.919 μs | −38.9% |
| Prefill | `[80, 4, 4096]` | 90 | 48.709 μs | 41.859 μs | −14.1% |
| Prefill | `[1, 4, 4096]` | 90 | 29.469 μs | 31.170 μs | +5.8% |
| Decode | `[2, 4, 4096]` | 1,890 | 37.090 μs | 34.130 μs | −8.0% |
- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c4df37dfcc7f72ca41cd43801a468526ecf99a2b
